::: {.hero-left}
[Mahshad *Sarikhani*]{.hero-name data-semantic-h1="true"}

[MD · quantitative and computational methods for IBD imaging]{.hero-tagline}

::: {.hero-bio}
A doctor who codes. I work on quantitative imaging in inflammatory bowel disease: how to turn an MRI finding into a measurement we can trust, and how to know when that measurement is useful.

I came to this as a clinician, so the disease question comes first for me. Most of my work is in ulcerative colitis, using MR enterography and motility MRI to study inflammation, structural change, and bowel function.

:::
